facts.text: John described seeing his bride walking down the aisle as a magical moment that made him emotional.

evidence.quote: seeing her walking down the aisle, her face lit up and it got me all choked up. What a magical moment - one I'll always remember.

facts.text: John mentioned that they had their first dance at a cozy restaurant with candlelight and music.

evidence.quote: We had our first dance at a cozy restaurant. It was so dreamy with the music and candlelight.

facts.text: Tim referenced an image of John and his bride dancing at their wedding.

evidence.quote: I saw your photo of you two dancing, it must have been incredible.

facts.text: John expressed that having everyone at the wedding made the day extra special.

evidence.quote: It was so dreamy with the music and candlelight. We were so lucky to have everyone with us!
